name: Pin Generator
author: Oliver Boyers

sections.description:
Pin Generator turns your WordPress blog posts and WooCommerce products into scroll-stopping Pinterest pins — with AI images, on-brand design, and optional scheduling to Pinterest.

Connect once with your free Pin Generator API key, then create pins from the Posts screen, auto-generate when you publish, place pins on your content, and send approved pins to Pinterest.

Why bloggers and store owners use it

  • AI Pinterest pins from your real posts and product pages
  • WooCommerce product pins alongside regular WordPress posts
  • Auto-generate on publish so new content gets pins without extra work
  • Design profile so every pin matches your brand colours and style
  • Classic templates if you prefer fixed layouts around your photos
  • Place pins on posts (top, middle, end) or keep them Pinterest-only
  • Schedule to Pinterest after you approve — nothing posts without you
  • Yoast / Rank Math focus keyphrase support for better pin SEO
  • 10 free WordPress credits to try before starting a plan (+20/month with attribution)

How it works

  1. Install Pin Generator and paste your API key from pingenerator.com/profile
  2. Analyse your site into a design profile (or pick classic templates)
  3. Create pins from a post, or turn on auto-generate when you publish
  4. Pins appear on the post; approve in Pin Generator to schedule to Pinterest

Create templates, review batches, and manage Pinterest scheduling at pingenerator.com.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to your WordPress site and activate it
  2. Open Pin Generator in wp-admin
  3. Paste your API key from pingenerator.com/profile (or sign up free)
  4. Save to connect, then configure design and publishing rules
sections.faq:
How do I create Pinterest pins from WordPress posts?

Open the Posts list, use Create pins on any post, choose Fully AI or classic templates, and generate. Pins are written back to the post when ready.

Does Pin Generator work with WooCommerce?

Yes. Create Pinterest pins for WooCommerce products the same way as posts, including auto-generate when a product is published.

Can pins be generated automatically when I publish?

Yes. Enable create-on-publish in Pin Generator settings. New posts and products can get AI or template pins automatically.

Can I schedule pins to Pinterest from WordPress?

Pins are created as drafts. When you are ready, approve and schedule them to Pinterest from Pin Generator (boards can be picked by AI).

Are the pin images AI-generated?

Fully AI pins use your design profile for unique on-brand images. You can also use classic templates built around your own photos.

Is there a free trial?

Yes — new connections include 10 free WordPress credits so you can try the plugin before starting a plan. Attribution can add +20 free credits per month.
